title: cache_miss
description: Close/event: a cache lookup miss at the given layer. Layer `etag` is the conditional-request answer at the transfer boundary: a hit there is the 304 decision, made before any resource runs.

durationMs.description: wall time from the scope opening to this close, in milliseconds. What is included depends on the layer and the outcome: layer resource/donut-view -> hit = serving from the pool; miss = resource run, and the write it triggered only for the cold (lone) and write-failed cases; layer etag -> the ETag pool lookup only, the resource runs after a false return if at all. Null on a bare event: an inner lookup has no scope, so it has no duration to report and a zero would read as "instant". A measurement, not a contract: it moves with the machine, the pool and the payload.
